EC1: Personal or family history of pancreatitis
EC2: Medullary thyroid carcinoma [OR] (MTC) or Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia Syndrome Type 2 (MEN 2)
EC4: Allergy to liraglutide [OR] or any of the active ingredients in liraglutide or other GLP-1 analogue
EC5: Weight loss [AND] drugs [NOT] other than metformin
EC6: Type 1 diabetes mellitus [OR] or diabetic ketoacidosis
EC7: Known major cognitive deficit [AND] dementia [OR], history of head trauma [OR] with loss of consciousness >30 min, history of stroke [OR], current central nervous system (CNS) disorder such as seizures [OR] or opportunistic CNS infection
EC8: Renal insufficiency [AND] defined as creatinine clearance < 60 mL/min
EC11: Unstable cardiovascular disease with hospitalization [AND] within 1 year for acute coronary syndrome
EC14: Active alcohol [OR] or opioid substitution therapy
EC15: Serious or unstable medical or psychological conditions that would compromise the subject's safety for successful participation
